_comment: Routes the contrast gate renders. PUBLIC ONLY, on purpose: a gate that
needs staging credentials is a gate that gets disabled the first time a
token rotates. Everything here renders for a logged-out visitor.
Authenticated surfaces (the ~135 V2 app pages) are NOT covered yet — they
need a seeded session, which is a follow-up. What is covered is every
surface a stranger can reach, which is also where a contrast bug is most
`settle` is extra ms to wait past networkidle, for pages whose intro
animations land on their final colours late.
